claims.claim: Heavy duty 2.5 Ton manual hydraulic pallet jack
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a faint number resembling '2500' near forks but it is not clearly legible; capacity cannot be confirmed.
No video of lifting, lowering, or hydraulic action is available; pump/seal condition not shown.
No service receipt, invoice, or dealer stamp visible in any photo.
Only one angle shown; underside, wheels, and hidden fasteners not photographed.
No brand name, logo, or model number visible on the unit to confirm manufacturer origin.

risks.risk: True load capacity may be lower than claimed 2.5 ton
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the capacity/ID plate stamped on the chassis
risks.if_unproven: price as unverified low-capacity unit (assume base/standard 2-ton class)

risks.risk: Hydraulic pump may leak or fail under load
risks.proof: Short video showing the jack lifting and holding a loaded pallet, then lowering smoothly
risks.if_unproven: price as not working / needs hydraulic service

risks.risk: Wheels/casters may be rusted or seized, affecting rolling
risks.proof: Video of the unit being pushed and turned on a flat floor
risks.if_unproven: price as poor mobility, factor in wheel replacement

risks.risk: Hidden rust or cracks on frame/forks not visible in the single shown photo
risks.proof: Photos of underside, fork tips, and both side panels
risks.if_unproven: price as cosmetically and structurally worn, worst-case rust damage

risks.risk: No proof of recent servicing claim
risks.proof: Dealer service receipt or invoice with date and unit identifier
risks.if_unproven: price as unserviced, standard used condition

risks.proof: Photo of manufacture date plate or serial number

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the capacity/ID plate on the chassis
Video of the jack lifting and lowering a loaded pallet
Video of wheels rolling and steering on flat ground
Photos of underside, both side panels, and fork tips
Any service receipt or invoice from the dealer
Photo of manufacturer logo, model number, or serial plate if present
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies the item as a generic hand pallet truck with visible wear and an illegible capacity marking, so it can be priced at worst case (unverified capacity, unverified working condition) pending the listed proofs.
